_comment: This is a small curated seed list for hackathon demo purposes only (56 entries across 15 exchanges). It does NOT represent complete or comprehensive VASP address coverage. Addresses are sourced from public forensics trackers and disclosures as cited per-entry. Entries sourced from WalletExplorer.com record cluster membership as labelled by that service, which is an attribution by a third party, not a disclosure by the exchange.
